text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
The air is so clear and refreshing..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Zealous so early in the morning, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You are going for a run, yes?
Do you mind if I accompany you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Of course. But—
what are you doing here at this hour too, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't try telling me you've forgotten about last year's first snowfall.
Who was it that went running in the morning and didn't come back all day?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Hehe, did something like that really happen?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you get away with that this year.
I'll be keeping watch right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you as always, Air Groove.
Well then, let's get going right away."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what an impatient fellow.
——Don't go too fast out there!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it because of the clear winter air?
Air Groove's footsteps running beside me sound—)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it because of the early morning silence?
The sound of Suzuka's breathing running beside me is――――)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: (It feels closer than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Suzuka. Stop for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's about that time.
Let's head back to the academy soon.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Is it that time already?
It felt like it went by in the blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly...
If I didn't say anything, it feels like you'd just keep running forever."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... When that time comes, Air Groove,
you'll come chasing after me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just like in a race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph.
Just like in a race, I won't let you get away. Prepare yourself.
